name: log-analyzer-cwm-sol
description: Analyse the syslogs during Pre and Post upgrade phase. The output should be a "success" if there are no logs with severity from 0 to 2, "failure" if the log level is 0/1 and "warning" if the log level is 2.

definition.name: log-analyzer-cwm-sol

dataConditions.name: check-iosxr
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco 8000 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540L Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5700 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 9000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco XRv 9000 Series Virtual Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5500 Series") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540 Series Routers") }

dataConditions.name: check-iosxe
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 920 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or  (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 900 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 1000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9300 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 8000V Edge Chassis Platforms") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 3650 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 8300 Series Edge Platforms") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 series switches") }

data.template:
Value node (\S+)
Value timeStamp ([a-zA-Z]{3}\s+\d+\s\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}.\d{3}\s[a-zA-Z]{3})
Value process (\S+)
Value category (\S+)
Value group (\S+)
Value severity (\S+)
Value code (\S+)
Value message (.*)

Start
  ^${node}:${timeStamp}:\s${process}:\s%${category}-${group}-${severity}-${code}\s:\s${message} -> Record

expressions.message: Severity 2 messages logged. System under critical conditions. Please contact Cisco TAC.

logs.message: Forming inputs for log analyzer check

data.template:
Value timeStamp ([a-zA-Z]{3}\s+\d+\s\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}.\d{3})
Value group (\S+)
Value severity (\S+)
Value code (\S+)
Value message (.*)

Start
  ^.${timeStamp}:\s%${group}-${severity}-${code}:\s${message} -> Record

expressions.message: Severity 2 messages logged. System under critical conditions. Please contact Cisco TAC.

logs.message: Forming inputs for log analyzer check

actionDataFilter.fromStateData: ${({"device": ."app-data".device.name, "NSOResourceId": ."app-data"."resource", "rak-resource": "cwm.sol.system.util", "command": (if ((."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 1000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9300 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 3650 Series Switches")) then ("show logging") else (if .logAnalyzer.lastLines != null then ("show logging last " + (.logAnalyzer.lastLines | tostring)) else "show logging last 30" end) end), "template": .template, "expressions": .expressions, "vendor": "Cisco Systems"})}

dataConditions.name: output is valid
dataConditions.condition: ${ if .rakutilExecutorData.status=="success" then true else false end}

dataConditions.name: output is not valid
dataConditions.condition: ${ if .rakutilExecutorData.status=="failed" then true else false end}

dataConditions.name: output has warnings
dataConditions.condition: ${ if .rakutilExecutorData.status=="warning" then true else false end}

logs.message: Log analyzer check completed with severity 0 or 1 or 2 messages found in logs.

stateDataFilter.output: ${{status:"warning", message: "Severity 0 or 1 or 2 messages logged. System under critical conditions. Please contact Cisco TAC.", stash: .rakutilExecutorData.nsoResponse}}

logs.message: Log analyzer check completed with errors.
Selected product series is not supported

stateDataFilter.output: ${{status:"failed", message: "Selected product series is not supported." }}

definition.description: Analyse the syslogs during Pre and Post upgrade phase. The output should be a "success" if there are no logs with severity from 0 to 2, "failure" if the log level is 0/1 and "warning" if the log level is 2.

lastLines.title: Number of Log Lines
lastLines.description: Number of most recent log lines to analyze for severity issues (default: 30)
